## Demand Estimation

Structural models of what consumers choose, and what those choices imply about preferences, substitution patterns, and counterfactual prices. Roughly the reading list for a PhD course on the subject.

#### Textbooks & Surveys

 - [Discrete Choice Methods with Simulation](https://eml.berkeley.edu/books/choice2.html) by Kenneth Train (2009)
 - McFadden (1984) Chapter 24 Econometric analysis of qualitative response models [[link](https://doi.org/10.1016/S1573-4412(84)02016-X)]
 - Ackerberg et al. (2007) Chapter 63 Econometric Tools for Analyzing Market Outcomes [[link](https://doi.org/10.1016/S1573-4412(07)06063-1)]
 - Chintagunta & Nair (2011) Discrete Choice Models of Consumer Demand in Marketing [[link](https://doi.org/10.1287/mksc.1110.0674)]
 - Dubé (2019) Chapter 1 - Microeconometric models of consumer demand [[link](https://doi.org/10.1016/bs.hem.2019.04.001)]
 - Berry & Haile (2021) Foundations of Demand Estimation [[link](https://doi.org/10.1016/bs.hesind.2021.11.001)]
 - Gandhi & Nevo (2021) Chapter 2 - Empirical models of demand and supply in differentiated products industries [[link](https://doi.org/10.1016/bs.hesind.2021.11.002)]
 - Hortaçsu & Joo (2023) Structural Econometric Modeling in Industrial Organization and Quantitative Marketing [[link](https://doi.org/10.1515/9780691251004)]

#### Foundations

 - McFadden (1973) Conditional Logit Analysis of Qualitative Choice Behavior [[link](https://eml.berkeley.edu/reprints/mcfadden/zarembka.pdf)]
 - Hausman & Wise (1978) A Conditional Probit Model for Qualitative Choice: Discrete Decisions Recognizing Interdependence and Heterogeneous Preferences [[link](https://doi.org/10.2307/1913909)]
 - Small & Rosen (1981) Applied Welfare Economics with Discrete Choice Models [[link](https://doi.org/10.2307/1911129)]
 - Guadagni & Little (1983) A Logit Model of Brand Choice Calibrated on Scanner Data [[link](http://www.jstor.org/stable/184043)]
 - Dubin & McFadden (1984) An Econometric Analysis of Residential Electric Appliance Holdings and Consumption [[link](https://doi.org/10.2307/1911493)]
 - Hanemann (1984) Discrete/Continuous Models of Consumer Demand [[link](https://doi.org/10.2307/1913464)]
